basic_info.description: Fabulous four-bedroom, two and a half bath, freshly updated Edwardian featuring contemporary style coupled with old world warmth and located on the border of two highly coveted neighborhoods: Bernal Heights and Glen Park. The distinctive and peaceful front yard leads to a dramatic and tasteful facade setting the tenor for this special home with the winning combination of modern accents, period details, and the perfect blend of indoor/outdoor living.  The inviting formal entryway opens to a formal living area, dining room, half-bath, gorgeous wood floors, and a large gourmet kitchen with direct access to the deck and garden. The upper-level of the home has two spacious bedrooms with skylights, one with views, and an updated bathroom. The lower level of the home presents a flexible floor plan with an entertainment room, laundry area, remodeled bathroom, office/bedroom, and an additional bedroom with direct access to the yard. The magnificent, majestic, and tranquil outdoor space is truly unique in San Francisco with mature landscaping in a park-like setting offering a gardener's paradise, or simply the perfect atmosphere for outdoor entertainment and leisure under the Bernal Heights sun. Do not miss this special home that is close to everything!
